name: QoL Mod Menu
description: A quality-of-life mod menu for Geometry Dash with handy toggles: hide attempts/UI, show FPS, disable background shake, disable flash effects, and auto-features for practice mode.

hide-attempts.name: Hide Attempts Label
hide-attempts.description: Hides the attempt counter label while playing a level.

hide-percentage.name: Hide Percentage Label
hide-percentage.description: Hides the percentage counter label while playing a level.

disable-shake.name: Disable Screen Shake
disable-shake.description: Disables the camera shake effect triggered by shake game objects.

disable-flash.name: Disable Flash Effects
disable-flash.description: Disables the white/colored flash effects from certain triggers.

show-fps.name: Show FPS Counter
show-fps.description: Displays a live FPS counter in the corner of the screen.

auto-checkpoint.name: Auto Checkpoint (Practice)
auto-checkpoint.description: Automatically places a practice checkpoint every few seconds while in practice mode.

auto-checkpoint-interval.name: Auto Checkpoint Interval (sec)
auto-checkpoint-interval.description: How often (in seconds) to automatically place a checkpoint in practice mode.

disable-death-effect.name: Disable Death Particles
disable-death-effect.description: Removes the particle burst effect when the player dies, for a cleaner screen.
